units.source_text: 胧月夜还是同从前一样妩媚多情。

en.t: Oborozukiyo was still as charming and passionate as ever.

units.source_text: 她一方面恐惧流言，一方面贪恋欢情，左右为难，愁容可掬。

en.t: On one hand she feared gossip, and on the other she clung to the pleasures of love, so she was torn between the two and wore a deeply troubled expression.

units.source_text: 源氏看到这神情，觉得比新相知更加可爱，虽然天色渐明，还是依依不舍，全无回去的意思。

en.t: Seeing her like this, Genji found her even more lovable than a newly won lover, and though dawn was breaking, he lingered fondly and had no thought of leaving.

units.source_text: 异常美丽的黎明天空中，飞鸟千百成群，鸣声清脆悦耳。

en.t: In the extraordinarily beautiful dawn sky, hundreds and thousands of birds flew in flocks, their clear calls pleasing to the ear.

units.source_text: 春花皆已散落，枝头只剩有如烟如雾的新绿。

en.t: All the spring blossoms had fallen, leaving only fresh green on the branches, like mist or smoke.

units.source_text: 源氏想起：昔年内大臣举办藤花宴会，正是这个时候。

en.t: Genji remembered that the wisteria banquet once held by the Minister of the Interior had taken place at just this season.

units.source_text: 虽然事隔多年，而历历回思当日情景，实甚可恋。

en.t: Although many years had passed, the scene of that day came back vividly to him and filled him with deep longing.

units.source_text: 中纳言君开了边门，准备送他回去。

en.t: Chunagon no Kimi opened the side gate and prepared to see him off.

units.source_text: 但源氏走到门口，又回转来，说道：“这藤花真美丽啊！

en.t: But when Genji reached the gate, he turned back again and said, "How beautiful these wisteria flowers are!

units.source_text: 怎么会染成如此可爱的色彩呢！

en.t: How could they have been dyed in such lovely colors!

units.source_text: 我无论如何也舍不得离开这花阴了！”

en.t: I simply cannot bear to leave the shade of these flowers!"

units.source_text: 他逡巡不忍遽去。

en.t: He hesitated, unable to bring himself to leave at once.

units.source_text: 其时朝日从山间升起，灿烂的阳光照着源氏，使得他的容姿越发美丽，令人目眩。

en.t: Just then the morning sun rose from between the mountains, and its brilliant light shone on Genji, making his figure still more beautiful and almost dazzling to behold.

units.source_text: 中纳言君多年不曾看见他，觉得他年纪越大，相貌越是俊俏，竟是世间所少有的。

en.t: Chunagon no Kimi had not seen him for many years, and she felt that the older he grew, the more handsome he became, a rare beauty in this world.

units.source_text: 她回忆当年，想道：“我家尚侍依附这位大人，有何不可呢？

en.t: Thinking back on those days, she wondered, "What would have been wrong with our Naishi no Kami relying on this gentleman?

units.source_text: 她虽然入宫，毕竟不是女御或更衣，而是个外勤的尚侍，其实不须与源氏大人分离。

en.t: Although she entered palace service, she was not a nyogo or a koi, but an attendant serving from outside, so in truth she did not need to part from Lord Genji.

units.source_text: 已故的弘徽殿太后却过分多心，以致引起了那不幸的须磨事件，轰动一时，又使我家尚侍流传了轻薄之名，而两人从此隔绝了。”

en.t: But the late Empress Mother of Kokiden was far too suspicious, and that brought about the unfortunate Suma affair, caused a great stir, gave our Naishi no Kami a reputation for frivolity, and separated the two of them from then on."

units.source_text: 两人胸中有诉说不尽的衷情，希望继续罄谈。

en.t: Both of them had feelings in their hearts that could never be fully told, and they wished to go on speaking until nothing was left unsaid.

units.source_text: 然而源氏为身份所羁，不便随意行止。

en.t: Yet Genji was constrained by his rank and could not come and go as he pleased.

units.source_text: 而这邸内人目众多，自非谨慎小心不可。

en.t: And with so many watchful eyes inside the residence, he had no choice but to act with the utmost caution.

units.source_text: 太阳渐渐高升，心中不免慌张。

en.t: As the sun gradually climbed higher, anxiety inevitably rose in his heart.

units.source_text: 此时车子已经来到廊门下，随从人等轻声咳嗽，表示催促。

en.t: By then the carriage had already come beneath the corridor gate, and the attendants gave soft coughs to signal that he should hurry.

units.source_text: 源氏召唤一个随从人来，叫他折一枝下垂的藤花，赋诗云：

en.t: Genji called one of his attendants over, told him to break off a drooping spray of wisteria, and composed this poem:
